text: DSH Notify 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的任务通知插件，通过 DSH 主机事件和页面覆盖层，把会话完成、失败、审批或提问显示为网页内提示卡。它提供可折叠的通知堆叠、任务状态区分、会话跳转、后台标签页提示音与设置页面。用户可以调整提示样式、位置、声音和子任务通知，并预览通知效果。适合希望在浏览器中及时看到 DSH 任务进度的用户；自定义声音和偏好可保存到配置的数据目录。

DSH Notify shows DSH task alerts in the web client. Host events create cards for completion, failure, approvals, or questions. It has a collapsible stack, session links, background sounds, and controls for style and subtask alerts. Preferences and custom sounds can be saved locally.
想让 DSH 任务结束时在网页里弹出提醒。
DSH 会话失败或需要我审批时，能在浏览器里通知我吗？

希望把网页里的多个任务通知折叠堆叠起来。
能不能从通知卡片直接回到对应的 DSH 会话？
我想调整提示卡样式、位置和声音。
Show me an in-page alert when a DSH task finishes.
Can I hear a cue when a task completes in a background tab?
DSH Notify 的功能「status-toast」：任务完成、失败、审批和提问会以不同状态的网页卡片呈现；事件到达后页面定时拉取并更新通知。
DSH Notify 的功能「stack」：通知卡片可折叠为堆叠列表，页面提供展开和清除操作，便于查看当前页面收到的多条提醒。
DSH Notify 的功能「session-navigation」：点击通知可打开相关会话并定位到对应活动，帮助用户从提醒返回任务上下文。
DSH Notify 的功能「sound」：通知可播放内置提示音，也可选择上传的自定义音频；声音由浏览器 WebAudio 或音频元素播放。

In-page task notifications for DeepSeek Harness: clear status toasts, a collapsible stack, sound, and background-tab attention. Live delivery only — notification records are never stored.

What it does · Quick start · Settings · Compatibility · Uninstall · Changelog

> DSH Notify is a DeepSeek Harness community plugin. It registers only a settings section and an in-page overlay; it does not modify DSH source.

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Introduction：When a session really stops, fails, asks a question, or needs approval, a card appears in the top-right corner of the current page. A green **Task completed** card follows DSH's native `agent/status: idle` transition — the same state that stops the session-tree spinner — rather than the earlier moment when text first looks complete. Intermediate goal rounds and queued follow-up turns stay quiet. Everything happens in the page you already have open: there is no service worker, web push, host OS notification, or notification history.

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Quick start：Requirements:

- DeepSeek Harness with a Web profile
- Node.js 24.9.0 or newer for current DSH (the plugin itself declares Node.js 20+)
- Verified DeepSeek Harness version: `0.2.2-rc.1`

Install from npm into your Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @idoall/dsh-notify@latest
```

Install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:idoall/dsh-notify"
```

From a local clone:

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Quick start：```sh
git clone https://github.com/idoall/dsh-notify.git
cd dsh-notify
npm install
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(pwd)"

Reload the profile or restart DSH only when its plugin host has not hot-reloaded the client. The client registers `settings.section` and `shell.overlay`; the host mounts through `cordis.patch.yml`.

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Quick start：> **Name note:** the unscoped npm name `dsh-notify` belongs to another author. Install this plugin as **`@idoall/dsh-notify`**. Its internal Cordis name, mount id, and `/plugins/dsh-notify/*` routes remain `dsh-notify`.
@idoall/dsh-notify README · Settings：**Settings → Notifications** provides a compact preview-first control surface:

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Settings：| Setting | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Toast position | conversation top-right | Anchors the overlay to the chat column and follows sidebar layout changes. |
| Notification style | **Enhanced** | Enhanced uses clear status colours and a short attention bar; Soft uses a quieter presentation. |
| Collapse multiple notifications | **on** | From two cards onward, show the newest card fully and stack older cards below it; hover or focus expands them. |
| In-page sound | **on** | Plays one cue when a polling batch admits one or more new visible Toasts, including while DSH is in a background tab. Built-ins: chime, ping, alert, silent; custom uploads are supported. |
| Subtask / background completion | **off** | Enables notifications for subagents, background jobs, and workflows, which can otherwise be noisy. |
| Preview and self-test | — | Sends page-local examples only: **Completed**, **Confirm**, **Failed**, **Info**, replay all four styles, fold the active examples, or clear them. No test sends a system notification or changes a real task. |

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Settings：Custom sounds are stored in `<dataDir>/sounds/` in the profile data directory, not the plugin installation. Uploads are limited to 1 MB and `mp3 / m4a / aac / wav / ogg / flac`; names must be a single path segment.

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Settings：Above the cards, the page shows the running version against the newest one on npm: `v0.4.13 ✓ 最新`, `v0.4.12 ➔ v0.4.13`, or `v0.4.13 · 检查失败`. **检查更新** forces a fresh lookup (`GET /plugins/dsh-notify/update?force=1`, authenticated); a page load reuses the host's six-hour cache. When a newer version exists the row reveals `dsh plugin --profile web add @idoall/dsh-notify@<version>` with a copy button — installing it, and restarting DSH afterwards, stays your decision.

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @idoall/dsh-notify
```

Uninstalling does not delete uploaded sounds or `settings.json` in the profile data directory. Notification records are never written to disk.

@idoall/dsh-notify README · Releasing：Releases are tag-driven. Bump `package.json` and the lockfile root versions, synchronize both READMEs and the DSH declarations, move the matching CHANGELOG section out of `Unreleased`, write `release-notes/v<version>.md`, then push the release commit and tag:

```sh
git tag v0.4.13
git push origin v0.4.13
```

The release workflow runs `npm run verify`, packs the plugin, publishes through npm trusted publishing (OIDC), and creates a GitHub Release with the package tarball and sha256.
